item.statement: No result relation other than point-sampled exact permutation is allowed; the candidate must not perform linear/bilinear filtering or any neighbor arithmetic.

plans.objective: Verify the candidate implements point sampling with no filtering arithmetic.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the indexing/load logic.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff each output element is loaded from exactly one source index derived from the shift, with no neighbor weights or interpolation.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate kernel for any weighted combination of neighboring source elements, and confirm a single source element is selected per output element.
